notes.title: New content for Effie on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey dear travelers of Oblena!

We've just released new content for Effie on Steam, which includes:
[list]
[*] 7x Trading Cards
[*] 6x Badges
[*] 4x Profile Backgrounds
[*] 5x Emoticons
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/a8660977dd3fb7cccc7a7f22b0df76a334ada71b.png[/img]

If you've already played the game, you should have received some Effie trading cards. If not... what are you waiting for?

Gotta catch 'em all! ːgalandshieldː
